opportunities.name: Nimbus AP attack hybrid
opportunities.objective: Test nimbus ap attack hybrid against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Nimbus Strike has 1.0 AP magic damage and grants five seconds of attack speed; Nashor and Dusk and Dawn reward Wukong's own attacks after arriving. Gunblade retains AD for Q and Cyclone, while Terminus supports mixed damage; clone contributions are logged separately.
opportunities.requiredState: E lands and personal attacks connect before the speed buff ends.
opportunities.failure: AP weakens physical Q/R and poor clone placement loses pressure.
opportunities.test: Compare E magic damage plus owner attacks with clone commanded or positioned away.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The clone's 40-60% damage statement does not establish full item on-hit inheritance.

opportunities.name: Stone Skin health conversion
opportunities.objective: Test stone skin health conversion against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Stone Skin grants stacking armor and max-health regeneration from owner or clone hits, making item health useful during repeated Q/Cyclone contact. Bloodmail supplies AD for physical spells; Titanic strengthens owner attacks, while Visage supports regeneration and Sundered Sky's first attack heal.
opportunities.requiredState: Build real passive stacks through champion/monster hits and keep Q contact.
opportunities.failure: Disengage expires five-second stacks and healing reduction reduces recovery.
opportunities.test: Measure owner regeneration and Q damage with zero versus five passive stacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Clone hits help the passive, but cannot be assumed to trigger a second Sundered Sky heal.

ruledOut.reason: The clone's 40-60% damage statement does not establish full item on-hit inheritance.

unknowns: Current-patch proc ordering/effectiveness is untested; symbolic source stats and helper form/pet records are not runtime dispatch proof.

builds.name: Nimbus AP attack hybrid
builds.summary: Test nimbus ap attack hybrid against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test nimbus ap attack hybrid against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Nimbus Strike has 1.0 AP magic damage and grants five seconds of attack speed; Nashor and Dusk and Dawn reward Wukong's own attacks after arriving. Gunblade retains AD for Q and Cyclone, while Terminus supports mixed damage; clone contributions are logged separately.
testPlan: Required state: E lands and personal attacks connect before the speed buff ends.
Compare E magic damage plus owner attacks with clone commanded or positioned away.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: AP weakens physical Q/R and poor clone placement loses pressure.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The clone's 40-60% damage statement does not establish full item on-hit inheritance.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Hextech Gunblade, Rabadon's Deathcap, Terminus, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Wukong dashes to an enemy, sending out Clones that mimic the dash to up to [2] additional enemies nearby. Each enemy struck takes [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (1) × AP] magic damage. He and his Clone gain [(0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6) × 100]% Attack Speed for [5] seconds.

Wukong gains [20]% Move Speed and spins his staff, Knocking Up nearby enemies for [0.6] seconds and take [((1.375) × AD) × (2)] plus [(0.04 / 0.06 / 0.08) × (2)] max Health physical damage over [2] seconds.

This Ability can be cast a second time within [8] seconds before going on cooldown.

Wukong dashes and becomes Invisible for [1] second, leaving behind a stationary Clone for [4] seconds.

The Clone Attacks nearby enemies Wukong has recently damaged and will mimic his ultimate, each dealing [(0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6) × 100]% of normal damage.

Wukong gains [characterLevelInterpolation(6 → 10; raw flags preserved)] Armor and regenerates [0.35]% max Health per 5 seconds. These bonuses are increased by [100]% for [5] seconds every time he or his Clone hit an enemy champion or jungle monster with an Attack or Ability, stacking up to [5] times.
